title: Unit 8 · oo
description: 15 câu · moon · zoo · food · boot · Nghe, nhìn tranh, phân loại, xếp thứ tự, nối cặp.

items.title: Unit 8 · oo
items.prompt: Listen and choose the correct picture.
items.spokenPrompt: Listen and choose the correct picture.
items.hint: Listen again. Look carefully, then choose.
items.why: Titi said “moon”. Match the whole spoken word to its picture.

items.title: Unit 8 · oo
